decisions.decision: One ReportSet reader shared by bugs and ideas
decisions.why: bugReports.ts is already that shape with the constants inlined
The two panes differ only in data

decisions.decision: Install and empty states are single tree rows
decisions.why: The decision was a row in the pane, and welcome content cannot coexist with rows

decisions.decision: Row values are matched against Spec Kit command vocabulary
decisions.why: The files are written by people and assistants, and the reader passes raw text today

decisions.decision: The viewer bug path becomes a report path keyed by set
decisions.why: Everything a bug panel switches off should be off for an idea
decisions.rejected: A second read-only mode for ideas

decisions.why: A bug has to be on screen without a click, which was the reason for choosing panes

decisions.decision: The viewer keeps state.bug as the read-only flag and adds reportSet
decisions.why: Many checks gate on it, and a rename would touch all of them

plan.summary: A shared report-set reader, one configurable pane provider, a generalised read-only viewer path, and bugs out of the Specs tree
plan.key_finding: A bug report kind is named assessment and the ideas directory is named assessments, so path helpers must key on the directory

tasks.summary: 19 tasks: Foundational (7), US1 (4), US2 (4), US3 (2), Polish (2)

implement.summary: Bugs and Ideas panes on a shared report reader, with ideas opening read-only in the viewer

approach: A generic report-set reader serves bugs and ideas. One tree provider configured twice draws the panes, with a single install or empty row when there is nothing to list. Ideas open through the viewer read-only report path, generalised from bug to report set, and bugs leave the Specs tree.
